titolo: leanrea tool cuts reverse‑engineering task time by 38% and cost by 35% versus REA
descr: The 8 KB leanrea skill drops the MCP layer of REA, delivering faster, cheaper reverse‑engineering on macOS arm64.
paragrafi: The GitHub project aicodeking/leanrea offers an 8 KB skill that replaces the REA (Reverse Engineer Anything) framework.
Benchmarks on macOS arm64 using Claude Code (Sonnet 5.5) show leanrea completing four reverse‑engineering tasks in 388 seconds at a cost of $2.17, compared with REA's 627 seconds and $3.36.
The leanrea approach removes the MCP server and 207 predefined tool definitions, letting the agent run native commands directly.
Against a baseline with no skill, leanrea is about 19 % faster and uses 32 % fewer turns, while its advantage over REA is larger at 38 % faster and 35 % cheaper.
Installation is via the skills CLI (e.g., npx skills add aicodeking/leanrea) or manual copy into the agent’s skill directory.
perche: For users, leanrea reduces both runtime and expense for reverse‑engineering workflows, especially on macOS arm64 machines. Developers of free or local AI agents can adopt the skill without adding a heavy MCP layer, keeping deployments lightweight and cost‑effective.
titoloFonte: aicodeking/leanrea: One 8 KB skill that replaces REA (Reverse Engineer Anything): plain CLI tools, no MCP. Benchmarked: 38% faster, 35% cheaper.
